tagline: The world's leading testing, inspection and certification company
hero_kpi_rationale: Revenue is the primary performance indicator for SGS, a global player in testing and certification.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Money earned by the company through its testing and inspection services.
kpis.description: Revenue reflects global demand for compliance and quality services, driven by international regulations.
kpis.signal: Solid growth in industrial certification services

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Profit generated before interest and taxes relative to revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin demonstrates the company's ability to control costs while growing.

kpis.name: R&D Investments as Percentage of Revenue
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue invested in research and development.
kpis.description: R&D activities are limited to analysis methodologies and regulatory compliance.
kpis.signal: Low R&D intensity typical of testing services

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on new equipment or laboratories.
kpis.description: Capex supports analysis capacity and compliance with new standards.
kpis.signal: Renewal and modernization of technical infrastructure

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.description: Headcount reflects geographic expansion and demand for local inspections.

kpis.name: Dividends Per Share
kpis.description: Dividends per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 reported fiscal years by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividends per share of 3.2 CHF in the last year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of 0.222 bn CHF in the last year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio: Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Portion of net income distributed as dividends: 33.2% in the last year.

ai_positioning.summary: SGS adopts a cautious approach to artificial intelligence, progressively integrating it into analysis and reporting processes without making it a major strategic lever.
evidence: Use of AI for automation of certain analysis readings
Limited deployment to specific use cases such as anomaly detection
Absence of AI mentions in strategic priorities or financial results
